A '''fractal transmitter''' was a type of technology. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Tanoa Vills]] used fractal transmitters, [[XJ5 circuit board]]s and [[octave regulator]]s to to build a [[sequencer]] that could be used in a [[security beacon]].<ref name="SWG:GtPfaS" />
